# Community code of conduct

## Our standard

Project spaces should be safe, respectful, and useful. Be considerate, assume
good faith while still discussing evidence, welcome people with different
backgrounds and experience levels, and critique ideas or code rather than
people.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, threats, unwanted
sexual attention, deliberate intimidation, sustained disruption, doxxing, or
publishing another person's credentials, private code, transcripts, logs, or
identifying information without permission.

## Scope and enforcement

This standard applies in project repositories, issue trackers, review threads,
community spaces, and when representing the project elsewhere. Maintainers may
edit or remove content, reject contributions, temporarily restrict participation,
or permanently ban participants when necessary to protect the community.

Report conduct concerns privately to the repository owner through an established
private channel. Do not use a public issue when that would repeat harassment,
private information, or security-sensitive material. Reports will be considered
in good faith, with confidentiality limited to what is reasonably necessary to
investigate and respond.

Maintainers who have a conflict of interest should recuse themselves from the
response. Retaliation against a person making a good-faith report is itself a
violation.
